mapper.select: INSERT INTO merchant_refund ( refund_reference, order_id, original_reference, merchant_reference, idempotency_key, psp_refund_reference, created_ts ) VALUES ( #{refundReference}, #{orderId}, #{originalReference}, #{merchantReference}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{pspRefundReference}, now() ) RETURNING refund_id, refund_reference, order_id, original_reference, merchant_reference, idempotency_key, psp_refund_reference, created_ts
